tools.name: run_items_by_condition
tools.description:
Items in a given physical condition.

Use when: Which items are worn or damaged; a list of items by condition.

Examples:
- Which items are damaged? Arguments: {"condition": "damaged"}

condition.description: The condition to look for. Values: new - Unused.; good - Used, fully functional.; worn - Visible wear, still functional.; damaged - Not safe or not able to be used..

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

tools.name: run_items_in_location
tools.description:
Items stored in a location.

Use when: What is stored in a place; which items sit in a given location.

Examples:
- What is in the main storage room? Supply the references it needs.

location.description: The location to list. An entity of class inv:Location: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

tools.name: do_move_item
tools.description:
Store an item in another location.

Use when: An item is moved, relocated or put away somewhere else; replaces the place where it was stored.

Examples:
- Put the label printer into the second storage room.

item.description: The item that moves. An entity of class inv:Item: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

location.description: The location the item moves to. An entity of class inv:Location: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_reason.description: Why this change is made; recorded in the audit trail.

_dry_run.description: Check the preconditions and report what would change; nothing is written.

tools.name: do_retire_item
tools.description:
Take an item out of service for good.

Use when: An item is scrapped, written off or taken out of service.

Examples:
- The old label printer is scrapped.

item.description: The item to retire. An entity of class inv:Item: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_reason.description: Why this change is made; recorded in the audit trail. Required for this action.

_dry_run.description: Check the preconditions and report what would change; nothing is written.

tools.name: view_item_catalog
tools.description:
Every item and location with their attributes and relations, for renderers.

Use when: Export or render the whole inventory; not for one item.

_cursor.description: The next of the previous page of this view, with the same parameters; leave it out for the first page.

_page_bytes.description: Page size in bytes, at least 1024; the view's own size, else 12288.

tools.name: view_items_in_location
tools.description:
The items of one location, from the function of the same name.

Use when: What is stored in a given location, as a view; a view may be named like a function.

location.description: The location to list. An entity of class inv:Location: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.

_cursor.description: The next of the previous page of this view, with the same parameters; leave it out for the first page.

_page_bytes.description: Page size in bytes, at least 1024; the view's own size, else 12288.

tools.name: view_location_overview
tools.description:
A location with the items stored there.

Use when: What is stored in a place, how many units of what, and which function lists it too.

_entity.description: The entity to show. An entity of class inv:Location: its id, its alias or 8 to 32 trailing hex digits of its id; a name has to be looked up first.
